To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the MDP formed using RQE is the solution to a constrained optimization problem, 2) the RQE-based MDP is the MDP with minimum variance among MDPs, and 3) this MDP is the one that minimizes the sum of its variance and its distance to the global minimum variance portfolio (GMVP).

1) the MDP is not a portfolio of minimum variance, but rather of minimum risk; 2) the MDP’s risk reduction is due to a decrease in its idiosyncratic risk, which results from a reduction in the number of assets with the highest idiosyncrasy; and 3) the MDP can be improved by increasing the number of assets in the portfolio and by reducing the number of assets excluded from the MDP.

(a) the MDP based on RQE is an efficient and effective investment tool; (b) it can be used in a number of applications; (c) it can be implemented with a number of methods; (d) it is robust to estimation window, turnover, and estimation method; and (e) it can be improved by increasing the number of assets in the universe, by reducing the estimation risk, and by increasing the number or the quality of the assets in the universe.
